definitions.explanation: The designated day on which garbage, recyclables, or other waste is collected by the municipal service. An essential part of daily life in Japan, where garbage sorting and collection schedules are strictly followed.

examples.japanese: {燃|も}えるゴミの{収集日|しゅうしゅうび}は{火曜日|かようび}だ。
examples.english: Burnable garbage collection day is Tuesday.

examples.japanese: {収集日|しゅうしゅうび}を{確認|かくにん}してからゴミを{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please check the collection day before putting out your garbage.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したばかりで、{地域|ちいき}の{収集日|しゅうしゅうび}カレンダーをまだもらっていない。
examples.english: I just moved and haven't received the local garbage collection calendar yet.

notes:
USAGE:
{収集日|しゅうしゅうび} is most commonly used for garbage and recycling pickup schedules. In Japan, each type of waste ({燃|も}えるゴミ, {燃|も}えないゴミ, {資源|しげん}ゴミ, etc.) has its own designated collection day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ゴミの{収集日|しゅうしゅうび} (garbage collection day)
- {収集日|しゅうしゅうび}カレンダー (collection day calendar)
- {次|つぎ}の{収集日|しゅうしゅうび} (next collection day)
